import Foundation

actor Tracker {
  var active = 0
  var peak = 0
  var completed = 0
  func work(_ item: Int) async {
    active += 1
    peak = max(peak, active)
    try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(40))
    active -= 1
    completed += 1
  }
  func snapshot() -> (Int, Int) { (peak, completed) }
}

func launch(_ items: [Int], tracker: Tracker) -> [Task<Void, Never>] {
  var tasks: [Task<Void, Never>] = []
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(Task(priority: .utility) { [item] in
      await tracker.work(item)
    })
  }
  return tasks
}

let tracker = Tracker()
let tasks = launch([1, 2, 3, 4], tracker: tracker)
await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
  for task in tasks {
    group.addTask { await task.value }
  }
}
let (peak, completed) = await tracker.snapshot()
precondition(peak == 4 && completed == 4)
print("peak=\(peak), completed=\(completed)")
